documentation.title: MaxiSys MS906 Pro & MS906 Pro-TS User Manual
documentation.note: This is the version of the PDF document, not of the device software.

device_software.note: The manual does not print a diagnostic-software build number. The manual says only that Settings shows general tablet information (p.13) and Update checks for updates (p.13); it does not state where the software version is displayed. Must be read and confirmed on the physical unit.
